ai/AITask.why: renders an agent task's task.jsonl, the day dashboard, the board

ext/Ask.why: talks to a Claude Code session from the browser

ext/Refine.why: a model refines one spoken prompt into cards

ext/Research.why: minions dig a question into append-only files

ext/Collab.why: a mastermind's members vote through phases

ext/Session.why: a voice session answered by the fast and smart assistants

ux/Dictate.why: voice to text through Whisper, sent to the agents (owner: 'strictly AI')
ux/Dictate.decision: propose: the first next move (31 importers, 400 mentions, the phone page)

ux/Revise.why: the LLM step of dictation: an LLM plus a prompt cleans speech

ux/Understand.why: the assistant marks each sentence clear or not and asks

ux/Rename.why: a title rename with suggested names; the suggester can be any source

ux/Card.why: the look of an AI card's own page

core/Session.why: a record in a dated folder; AISession and RefineSession extend it
core/Session.decision: stay: a base class for any dated record

ext/Chat.why: a chat log and composer; any conversation, AI or not

ext/ErrorLog.why: a UI error becomes a log line a session can follow

ext/DesignTool.why: measures layouts with no AI at runtime; only vision/ calls a model

ext/Shots.why: screenshots, diffs, a judge click; AI is one reader

ext/Query.why: node returns the rows a page shows

ext/JSONL.why: append-only logs; AI is the main writer but any page uses it

ai/cards.why: a card and what it shows

ai/talk.why: a mic and one card of what you say

ai/sessions.why: the Sessions tab page and the session store
